title: Technology in Daily Life
description: Covers technology vocabulary, describing how gadgets and apps work, internet and social media language, and digital safety tips. Designed for A2 completers who use technology daily and want to discuss it confidently in English.

content.content: {"time":1700000301000,"blocks":[{"id":"aA1bB2cC3d","type":"paragraph","data":{"text":"A gadget is a small mechanical or electronic device that has a particular purpose. In modern life, we use dozens of gadgets every day."}},{"id":"dD4eE5fF6g","type":"paragraph","data":{"text":"Common gadgets and devices:"}},{"id":"gG7hH8iI9j","type":"list","data":{"style":"unordered","items":["Smartphone — a mobile phone with advanced computing capability","Laptop / tablet — portable computers for work and entertainment","Smartwatch — a wearable device that tracks fitness and displays notifications","Wireless earbuds — small audio devices that connect via Bluetooth","Smart speaker — a voice-controlled device (e.g. Amazon Echo)"]}},{"id":"jJ0kK1lL2m","type":"paragraph","data":{"text":"Useful verbs for describing gadgets:"}},{"id":"mM3nN4oO5p","type":"list","data":{"style":"unordered","items":["It allows you to... / It enables you to...","You can use it to... / It is designed to...","It connects to... / syncs with..."]}},{"id":"pP6qQ7rR8s","type":"paragraph","data":{"text":"Example: A smartwatch allows you to monitor your heart rate and receive messages without taking out your phone."}}],"version":"2.31.4"}

content.content: {"time":1700000302000,"blocks":[{"id":"sS9tT0uU1v","type":"paragraph","data":{"text":"When comparing technology from different periods, we often use comparative and superlative adjectives and phrases showing change over time."}},{"id":"vV2wW3xX4y","type":"paragraph","data":{"text":"Useful language for comparing technology:"}},{"id":"yY5zA6bB7c","type":"list","data":{"style":"unordered","items":["used to + infinitive — for habits or states in the past that no longer exist: People used to send letters instead of emails.","has/have become — to describe change: Smartphones have become much more powerful.","compared to / in contrast to — to highlight differences"]}},{"id":"cC8dD9eE0f","type":"paragraph","data":{"text":"Adjectives for comparison: faster, smaller, cheaper, more reliable, more efficient, more user-friendly, more powerful"}},{"id":"fF1gG2hH3i","type":"paragraph","data":{"text":"Examples:"}},{"id":"iI4jJ5kK6l","type":"list","data":{"style":"unordered","items":["Mobile phones used to be much larger and heavier than they are today.","Compared to desktop computers, laptops are far more portable.","Streaming services have replaced physical DVDs for most people."]}}],"version":"2.31.4"}

lessons.title: Types of Apps and What They Do

content.content: {"time":1700000303000,"blocks":[{"id":"lL7mM8nN9o","type":"paragraph","data":{"text":"An app (application) is a software program designed to perform a specific function on a device. There are thousands of apps available for different purposes."}},{"id":"oO0pP1qQ2r","type":"paragraph","data":{"text":"Categories of apps:"}},{"id":"rR3sS4tT5u","type":"list","data":{"style":"unordered","items":["Productivity apps — help you organise work and tasks (e.g. calendars, to-do lists, note-taking)","Social media apps — connect you with other people (e.g. Instagram, Facebook)","Navigation apps — help you find your way (e.g. Google Maps, Waze)","Entertainment apps — for fun and leisure (e.g. Netflix, Spotify)","Health apps — track your physical activity, diet, or mental wellbeing","Banking apps — let you manage money without visiting a branch"]}},{"id":"uU6vV7wW8x","type":"paragraph","data":{"text":"Key verbs: download, install, update, uninstall, launch, log in/out, subscribe to, stream"}},{"id":"xX9yY0zA1b","type":"paragraph","data":{"text":"Useful phrases: The app is free / available on iOS and Android / requires an internet connection / has a paid version."}}],"version":"2.31.4"}

content.text: First, download the app from the App Store. Then install it and log in with your email address.
First, [download] the app from the App Store. Then [install] it on your device and [log in] with your email address. If you want extra features, you can [subscribe] to the premium version.

lessons.title: Social Media: Key Terms and Expressions

content.content: {"time":1700000305000,"blocks":[{"id":"qQ7rR8sS9t","type":"paragraph","data":{"text":"Social media platforms have created a new set of vocabulary that is now part of everyday English. Understanding and using these terms correctly is important at B1 level."}},{"id":"tT0uU1vV2w","type":"paragraph","data":{"text":"Key social media terms:"}},{"id":"wW3xX4yY5z","type":"list","data":{"style":"unordered","items":["post (n/v) — a piece of content shared online; to share content","feed — the stream of posts you see on your home page","hashtag (#) — a word or phrase preceded by # to categorise content","influencer — a person with many followers who promotes products or ideas","viral — content that spreads rapidly and is seen by millions","tag — to link another user in your post or photo","DM (direct message) — a private message sent within a platform","story — a short-lived post that disappears after 24 hours"]}},{"id":"zA6bB7cC8d","type":"paragraph","data":{"text":"Opinion phrases for social media discussions:"}},{"id":"dD9eE0fF1g","type":"list","data":{"style":"unordered","items":["In my opinion, social media can be both useful and harmful...","I think one of the biggest advantages is...","On the other hand, it can lead to..."]}}],"version":"2.31.4"}

content.content: {"time":1700000306000,"blocks":[{"id":"gG2hH3iI4j","type":"paragraph","data":{"text":"At B1 level, you should be able to describe your social media habits using a variety of tenses and frequency expressions."}},{"id":"jJ5kK6lL7m","type":"paragraph","data":{"text":"Frequency adverbs and expressions: always, usually, often, sometimes, rarely, hardly ever, never; every day, once a week, several times a day"}},{"id":"mM8nN9oO0p","type":"paragraph","data":{"text":"Useful structures:"}},{"id":"pP1qQ2rR3s","type":"list","data":{"style":"unordered","items":["Present simple for regular habits: I check Instagram twice a day.","Present perfect for recent activity: I've just posted a photo from my holiday.","Used to for past habits: I used to spend hours on Facebook, but now I rarely use it."]}},{"id":"sS4tT5uU6v","type":"paragraph","data":{"text":"Expressing preferences:"}},{"id":"vV7wW8xX9y","type":"list","data":{"style":"unordered","items":["I prefer ... to ... because...","I tend to use ... more than...","What I like most about ... is..."]}}],"version":"2.31.4"}

content.text: I [usually] check social media in the morning. I [have recently started] using TikTok, but I [used to spend] most of my time on Instagram. These days I [tend to prefer] watching YouTube videos to scrolling through my feed.

content.content: {"time":1700000307000,"blocks":[{"id":"yY0zA1bB2c","type":"paragraph","data":{"text":"When we describe how technology works, we often use the passive voice because the focus is on the process, not the person doing it."}},{"id":"cC3dD4eE5f","type":"paragraph","data":{"text":"Passive voice structure: subject + is/are/was/were + past participle"}},{"id":"fF6gG7hH8i","type":"list","data":{"style":"unordered","items":["The data is stored in the cloud.","The photo was taken with a 108-megapixel camera.","Messages are encrypted before they are sent."]}},{"id":"iI9jJ0kK1l","type":"paragraph","data":{"text":"Sequence words for explaining processes: first, then, next, after that, finally, once, when, as soon as"}},{"id":"lL2mM3nN4o","type":"paragraph","data":{"text":"Full example: First, the image is captured by the camera sensor. Then, it is processed by the phone's chip. Finally, it is saved to the internal storage or uploaded to the cloud."}},{"id":"oO5pP6qQ7r","type":"paragraph","data":{"text":"This structure is very useful for describing technical processes, instructions, and how devices function."}}],"version":"2.31.4"}

content.text: The data is stored in the cloud. Messages are encrypted before they are sent.

content.content: {"time":1700000308000,"blocks":[{"id":"rR8sS9tT0u","type":"paragraph","data":{"text":"Digital communication includes emails, instant messages, and online chats. content.content: {"time":1700000310000,"blocks":[{"id":"dD4eE5fF6g","type":"paragraph","data":{"text":"Technology has transformed many aspects of modern life. At B1 level, you should be able to discuss these benefits using a range of vocabulary and structures."}},{"id":"gG7hH8iI9j","type":"paragraph","data":{"text":"Key benefits:"}},{"id":"jJ0kK1lL2m","type":"list","data":{"style":"unordered","items":["Communication — we can contact people anywhere in the world instantly","Access to information — knowledge is available to anyone with an internet connection","Convenience — online shopping, banking, and booking save time","Education — online courses and apps make learning more accessible","Healthcare — technology improves diagnosis, monitoring, and treatment"]}},{"id":"mM3nN4oO5p","type":"paragraph","data":{"text":"Opinion and argument phrases:"}},{"id":"pP6qQ7rR8s","type":"list","data":{"style":"unordered","items":["One of the main advantages of technology is...","Thanks to modern technology, it is now possible to...","Without technology, it would be much harder to...","Technology has made it easier for people to..."]}},{"id":"sS9tT0uU1v","type":"paragraph","data":{"text":"Conditional structure for discussing impact: If it weren't for technology, many people would not have access to quality education."}}],"version":"2.31.4"}

lessons.title: Online Risks and How to Stay Safe

content.content: {"time":1700000311000,"blocks":[{"id":"vV2wW3xX4y","type":"paragraph","data":{"text":"While technology offers many benefits, it also comes with risks. Being aware of online dangers and knowing how to protect yourself is essential."}},{"id":"yY5zA6bB7c","type":"paragraph","data":{"text":"Common online risks:"}},{"id":"cC8dD9eE0f","type":"list","data":{"style":"unordered","items":["Phishing — fake emails or messages designed to steal your personal information","Malware / virus — harmful software that damages your device or steals data","Cyberbullying — using technology to harass or threaten others","Identity theft — stealing someone's personal details to commit fraud","Data breach — when private information is accessed without permission"]}},{"id":"fF1gG2hH3i","type":"paragraph","data":{"text":"How to stay safe online — modal verbs for advice:"}},{"id":"iI4jJ5kK6l","type":"list","data":{"style":"unordered","items":["You should use a strong, unique password for each account.","You shouldn't click on links in suspicious emails.","You must enable two-factor authentication on important accounts.","You ought to update your software regularly."]}}],"version":"2.31.4"}

content.text: You should use a strong, unique password for each account and enable two-factor authentication.

content.content: {"time":1700000312000,"blocks":[{"id":"lL7mM8nN9o","type":"paragraph","data":{"text":"Artificial intelligence (AI) refers to computer systems that can perform tasks that normally require human intelligence, such as understanding language, recognising images, or making decisions."}},{"id":"oO0pP1qQ2r","type":"paragraph","data":{"text":"Key terms in AI and automation:"}},{"id":"rR3sS4tT5u","type":"list","data":{"style":"unordered","items":["machine learning — AI that improves by learning from data","automation — using technology to perform tasks without human involvement","chatbot — an AI program that simulates conversation","algorithm — a set of rules a computer follows to solve a problem","self-driving car — a vehicle that can navigate without a human driver"]}},{"id":"uU6vV7wW8x","type":"paragraph","data":{"text":"Speculating about the future — future forms:"}},{"id":"xX9yY0zA1b","type":"list","data":{"style":"unordered","items":["AI will transform many industries in the coming years.","Many jobs might be automated in the future.","It is likely that robots will replace some types of work.","I believe technology is going to play an even bigger role in education."]}}],"version":"2.31.4"}

content.content: {"time":1700000313000,"blocks":[{"id":"bB2cC3dD4e","type":"paragraph","data":{"text":"At B1 level, you should be able to present balanced arguments about technology's impact on society, using discourse markers and opinion phrases."}},{"id":"eE5fF6gG7h","type":"paragraph","data":{"text":"Discourse markers for balanced arguments:"}},{"id":"hH8iI9jJ0k","type":"list","data":{"style":"unordered","items":["On the one hand... On the other hand...","Although technology has many benefits, it also has drawbacks.","However / Nevertheless / Despite this...","In addition / Furthermore / Moreover..."]}},{"id":"kK1lL2mM3n","type":"paragraph","data":{"text":"Expressing strong opinions:"}},{"id":"nN4oO5pP6q","type":"list","data":{"style":"unordered","items":["I strongly believe that...","It seems clear to me that...","There is no doubt that..."]}},{"id":"qQ7rR8sS9t","type":"paragraph","data":{"text":"Expressing uncertainty:"}},{"id":"tT0uU1vV2w","type":"list","data":{"style":"unordered","items":["It is hard to say whether...","It remains to be seen if..."]}},{"id":"wW3xX4yY5z","type":"paragraph","data":{"text":"Example paragraph: On the one hand, social media allows people to stay connected with friends and family across the world.
